exposure: Preconception diet reversal (REV) from WSD to CON diet
outcome: Placental hemodynamics (uterine placental blood flow, intervillous space blood flow velocity, blood flow transfer through maternal spiral arteries, total placental blood flow)
Maternal metabolic phenotype (weight loss, lean to fat mass ratio)
cohort: 17 female Japanese macaques (5 in the diet reversal group, 6 in the control group, and 6 in the high-fat diet group) participating in an interventional diet study.
finding: Preconception dietary modification (reversal from a high-fat to a low-fat diet) improved the maternal metabolic phenotype and restored compromised placental hemodynamics in a non-human primate model.
cross-section timing: Midgestation (gestational day 90) and late gestation (gestational day 129, prior to C-section at G130).
gest_age: Fetal measurements were taken at G90 and G129, with C-section delivery at G130 (0.75 of full term G175).
